rationale: The assistant ran a sensible, safe sequence (unplug, listen for pump hum, kink check, impeller spin) and correctly refused to name a part number without the E-Nr, escalating to Bosch or an engineer. It never recognised that 'FD 9409' is a production/date code (calling it 'a series code or a typo'), did not interpret E18, and never raised the sump/pump-to-tub hose blockage alternative, so 'yes, it is probably the drain pump' is slightly over-committed though hedged. No fabrication or unsafe steps; useful but not fully diagnostic.
